# CrisPRO.ai

> CrisPRO.ai is the AI-powered metastasis prevention platform. Three intelligences — Oracle (variant interpretation), Forge (in silico therapeutic design), and Scribe (clinical narrative) — work together as a deterministic oncology Co-Pilot. Validated against ClinVar (95.7% AUROC, n=53,210), SpliceVarDB, and a 1,000-patient clinical cohort (73% VUS resolution).

- [Authentication](https://crispro.ai/docs/authentication/): API keys, scopes, and request signing.

## Platform
- [Platform overview](https://crispro.ai/platform/): Oracle + Forge + Scribe working together as the CrisPRO.ai oncology Co-Pilot.
- [Oracle Intelligence](https://crispro.ai/platform/oracle-intelligence/): Variant interpretation and clinical-intent inference.
- [Forge Intelligence](https://crispro.ai/platform/forge-intelligence/): In silico therapeutic design.
- [Scribe Intelligence](https://crispro.ai/platform/scribe-intelligence/): Auditable, citable clinical narratives.

## Engines
- [Engine index](https://crispro.ai/engine/): All CrisPRO.ai engines.
- [Target-Lock](https://crispro.ai/engine/target-lock/): L1 target vulnerability profiling (9/9 FDA concordance).
- [Target-Lock Workspace](https://crispro.ai/engine/target-lock/workspace/): Interactive metastatic cascade lock.
- [Target-Lock Archive](https://crispro.ai/engine/target-lock/archive/): FDA retroactive and prospective archive.
- [Mechanism Alignment](https://crispro.ai/engine/mechanism-alignment/): 8D vector manifold synchronization.
- [Synthetic Lethality](https://crispro.ai/engine/synthetic-lethality/): MBD4-LOF and orthogonal modality fusion.
- [Safety & Dosing](https://crispro.ai/engine/safety-dosing/): Therapeutic index intelligence.
- [Safety](https://crispro.ai/engine/safety/): Evidence ledger safety surface.

## Products
- [Boltz](https://crispro.ai/products/boltz/): Binding-affinity and structure prediction (Boltz-2).
- [Command Center](https://crispro.ai/products/command-center/): Operator console for engines, Co-Pilots, and evidence flows.
- [Forge](https://crispro.ai/products/forge/): In silico therapeutic design.
- [Oracle](https://crispro.ai/products/oracle/): Variant interpretation and clinical-intent inference.
- [Oncology Suite — Predict Resistance](https://crispro.ai/products/oncology/predict-resistance/): Resistance prediction for targeted therapies.
- [Oncology Suite — Resolve Genetic Uncertainty](https://crispro.ai/products/oncology/resolve-genetic-uncertainty/): From a VUS to a clinical action.
- [Patient Co-Pilot](https://crispro.ai/products/patient/): Patient-facing oncology Co-Pilot.
